name: Crater Crackdown
author: BEANZ
description_short: Retro arcade clone of asteroid shooter for Nintendo GameCube
description_long: An original Asteroids-inspired arcade shooter for Nintendo GameCube. Pilot a triangle spaceship, blast crater-covered asteroids into smaller fragments, and survive increasingly challenging waves. Features original synthesized sound effects, three starting lives, extra lives through scoring, and four seconds of flashing wave-start protection from wave 11 onward.
